settings.title: How long it lasts
settings.content: Up to two weeks, depending on placement, application and daily activity. Follow the included instructions for the longest wear.

settings.title: Skin-friendly ink
settings.content: Formulated to be gentle on skin. If you have sensitive skin, do a small patch test before full application.

settings.title: Application
settings.content:
Step 1: Clean and dry the area.
Step 2: Peel the film and press the tattoo face down.
Step 3: Wet the backing for 30 seconds, peel gently, and let it dry untouched. The design darkens over the next 24–48 hours.

settings.question: What if my order arrives damaged or wrong?

settings.question: Is there an aftercare process?
settings.answer: Yes — keep the area dry while the design develops, avoid scrubbing for the first 24 hours, and cover it loosely on the first night. Full aftercare notes ship with your order.

settings.question: How can I remove it faster?
settings.answer: Gentle daily exfoliation with a mild scrub or loofah speeds up the natural fade.

settings.heading: How to apply your tattoo
settings.steps:
Wipe the spot with the skin wipe and let it dry fully. No cream, oil or sweat.
Remove the clear film and place the tattoo face down. Hold it still.
Dip the tissue magic coin in water and press it firmly over the paper for 30 seconds.
Peel the paper off slowly from one corner. Let it dry; the ink darkens over 24 hours.
settings.note: Semi-permanent: lasts 1–2 weeks depending on your skin type, and may fade sooner on sensitive skin.
